deal.description:
**Buy or rent.** Optional; default `sale`.

- `sale`  -  listings for sale (the price is the full asking price, RUB)
- `rent`  -  listings for rent (the price is per month for long-term rent, per day for daily rent  -  see `rent_period`)

property_type.description:
**What kind of property.** Optional; default `flat`.

- **Residential:** `flat`  -  flats and apartments (narrow with `rooms`) · `room`  -  a room in a shared flat (комната) · `bed`  -  a bed (койко-место; rent only) · `flat_share`  -  a share of a flat (доля; sale only)
- **Suburban:** `house`  -  houses and cottages (дом, коттедж) · `house_part`  -  part of a house · `townhouse` · `land`  -  land plots (sale only)
- **Commercial:** `office` · `retail` (торговая площадь) · `warehouse` (склад) · `free_purpose` (помещение свободного назначения) · `public_catering` (общепит) · `garage` · `production` (производство) · `car_service` (автосервис) · `business` (готовый бизнес  -  a running business; sale only) · `building` (здание) · `domestic_services` (бытовые услуги) · `commercial_land` (коммерческая земля  -  plots for commercial use) · `coworking` (коворкинг  -  private offices and desks in a coworking centre; rent only)

**Rules**

- Comma-separated values must come from ONE group; mixing groups is rejected with 400 (run one search per group). Several values combine with **OR**.
- A kind listed for one deal only is rejected with 400 on the other: `bed` and `coworking` are rent only; `flat_share`, `land` and `business` sale only (plots offered for rent are `commercial_land`).
- Commercial types mean "suitable for": free-purpose premises declared suitable for an office also match `office`, so check each row's `category`.
- `office` for rent also matches coworking places (private offices and desks, rows with `coworking` set); `coworking` searches those alone.
- `commercial_land` is searched on its own, not with other types. Its rows carry `land_area_sotka` (or `land_area_ha`)  -  size it with `land_area_min` / `land_area_max`; `area_*` match only the few plots that state a floor area.
- `coworking` is searched on its own; narrow it with `coworking_type`, `workplaces_min` / `workplaces_max`, `coworking_amenities`, `all_day_access`, `all_week_access` and `coworking_ids`. Its rows state no area  -  an office's area is on its `/offer` card, desks have none.
- Ex: `flat,room`, `house,townhouse`, `office,free_purpose`.

rooms.description:
**Number of rooms of a flat.** Optional; omit for every layout.

- `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`  -  that many rooms · `6_plus`  -  six or more
- `studio`  -  studio (студия, incl. studio apartments) · `free_layout`  -  free layout (свободная планировка)

**Rules**

- Needs `flat` in `property_type` (else 400). Rooms, beds and shares are separate `property_type` values, not room counts.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned). Ex: `1,2` or `studio,1`.
- Rows carry `rooms` (`0` for a studio) and `is_studio`.

rent_period.description:
**Long-term or daily rent.** Optional; default `long` on `/search` and `/map-clusters`.

- `long`  -  long-term rent, priced per month (`price_period: month`)
- `daily`  -  daily rent (посуточно), priced per day (`price_period: day`); for stays on given dates, priced for the nights, use `/dailyrent-search` (houses and rooms there: `/dailyrent-search?property_type=house` / `room`)
- `any`  -  both together

**Rules**

- **Applies to `deal=rent` only**; on a sale search it is rejected with 400.
- Applies to residential and suburban rentals; commercial premises are rented long-term only (anything but `any` is rejected there).

building_stage.description:
**New build or resale.** Optional; applies to `deal=sale` with residential property types (else 400).

- `new`  -  new-build flats (новостройки), including flats in complexes still under construction
- `resale`  -  resale flats (вторичка)

The two together add up to every flat for sale. Rows carry `is_new_building`; a new-build row also names its complex in `newbuilding` (`newbuilding_id`).

region_id.description:
**Region or city to search in.** Optional; omit to search all of Russia.

- `1`  -  Moscow · `4593`  -  Moscow Oblast · `2`  -  Saint Petersburg · `4588`  -  Leningrad Oblast
- a city: `4777`  -  Kazan (city ids narrow to the city; region ids such as `4618` Tatarstan cover the whole region)

**Rules**

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Several ids combine with **OR** (`1,2` = every Moscow listing plus every Saint Petersburg listing).
- Get region ids from `/regions` and city / town ids (`location_id`) from `/locations`; `/geocode` suggestions with `search_param: region_id` work too.
- A metro, district, street, house, highway, railway, complex or polygon filter REPLACES the region as the search area (`developer_ids` does not  -  it narrows within the region).
- Do not list a region together with a city inside it: the search then covers about the city alone  -  the region by itself already covers its cities.
- The union of several places is not always exact, even for distant ones: query a large city on its own when completeness matters.
- With `village_id` send at most one region (several are rejected with 400).

metro_ids.description:
**Metro stations the listing must be near.** Optional. Ex: `228`  -  Строгино (Moscow), `4,118`.

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `station_id`s from `/metro-stations` (by city) or `/geocode` (by name).
- Add `max_metro_minutes` to bound the travel time.
- In **Moscow and Saint Petersburg** it returns the listings linked to the station, and rows carry it in `metro[].station_id`.
- In **other metro cities** (Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk, Nizhny Novgorod, Samara) listings are not linked to a station: the filter then selects a wide area around it  -  roughly a third to a half of the city  -  and rows carry an empty `metro`. Use `bbox` or `polygon` there for a real "near this station" search.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

district_ids.description:
**City districts (okrug or raion).** Optional. Ex: `13`  -  Арбат (Moscow).

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `district_id`s from `/districts` (by city) or `/geocode`.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

street_ids.description:
**Streets.** Optional. Ex: `1163`  -  улица Маршала Катукова (Moscow).

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `street_id`s from `/geocode` (a street name or an address resolves to its `street_id`); rows carry them in `address_parts`.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

house_ids.description:
**Individual buildings  -  every listing in one house.** Optional. Ex: `934162` (Маршала Катукова 24к6, Moscow).

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `house_id`s from `/geocode` (an address resolves to its `house_id`) or from `/map-clusters` pins (`house_id`).
- For a pin inside a new-build complex use its `newbuilding_id` with `newbuilding_ids` instead.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

highway_ids.description:
**Highways out of Moscow / Saint Petersburg (шоссе)**  -  the usual way to search country houses and land. Optional. Ex: `1`  -  Алтуфьевское.

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `highway_id`s from `/highways`; rows carry them in `highways[].highway_id` with the distance from the ring road.
- Pair with `mkad_distance_min_km` / `mkad_distance_max_km`.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

railway_ids.description:
**Suburban railway stations** the listing is near. Optional. Ex: `861`  -  Жаворонки (Moscow Oblast).

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `station_id`s from `/railway-stations` (every station of a region, by direction) or `/geocode` suggestions of type `railway_station`.
- Rows carry them in `railways[].station_id`  -  suburban rows and many regional flat and commercial rows; Moscow city rows usually carry none, and the filter still selects them near the station.
- Some regions' stations are linked to no listing, so their ids match nothing (see `/railway-stations`).
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

newbuilding_ids.description:
**Residential complexes (ЖК)  -  every listing in the complex.** Optional. Ex: `839`  -  ЖК «Янтарный город».

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `newbuilding_id`s from the rows' `newbuilding.newbuilding_id`, `/map-clusters` pins or `/geocode` suggestions of type `newbuilding`.
- Returns both developer sales and resales inside the complex.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.

developer_ids.description:
**A developer (застройщик)  -  listings inside the complexes it built**, developer sales and resales alike. Optional; ONE id per search (a list is rejected with 400). Ex: `6399`  -  ГК «Самолет».

- Get ids from `/developers` (every developer of a city or region), `/geocode` suggestions of type `developer` (`search_param: developer_ids`) or the `developer_id` of `/map-clusters` pins and `/newbuilding`.
- Unlike the place filters it does NOT replace the area: it narrows whatever else is sent (`region_id`, `metro_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`, …). Rows name the complex in `newbuilding`.
- A developer search stops returning rows well below its `total` and before page 54, and a price band does not help  -  as every search holding developers' own flats does (see `page`). One search per complex does: add `newbuilding_ids` with each `newbuilding.newbuilding_id` the rows name.

village_id.description:
**A cottage village (коттеджный посёлок)  -  every plot and house for sale in it.** Optional; one id. Ex: `20678`.

- Get ids from `/cottage-villages` (every village of a city, region or municipal district) or `/geocode` suggestions of type `cottage_village` (`search_param: village_id`); rows carry the same id in `village_id`.
- The village is the search area: `region_id` is not needed, and without a `property_type` every suburban kind is searched (houses, house parts, townhouses and plots).
- A `region_id` sent with it only narrows: a region that does not hold the village returns 0 (Moscow `1` still returns a Moscow Oblast village). `bbox` and `polygon` narrow it too.
- It cannot be combined with several `region_id`s, or with `metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids` or `newbuilding_ids`  -  both are rejected with 400.
- **Applies to suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `land`, `townhouse`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.

bbox.description:
**The map view to pin, as `west,south,east,north` in decimal degrees (longitude first).** Required. Ex: `37.38,55.79,37.44,55.82` (Strogino, Moscow).

- West must be less than east and south less than north (else 400).
- A dense view can fail to pin: a view holding more than 10,000 matching listings whose pins cannot be loaded returns 400 (after a few seconds) with the count, asking to zoom in or add filters; a view above 60,000 is refused at once.
- Size a view first with `/search` and the same `bbox` (its `total`); the view check uses its own count (returned here as `total`), which can differ from the `/search` `total`.

polygon.description:
**Any shape to search in**  -  a district outline, a walking radius, a strip along a river. Optional.

- Format: the corner points `lng,lat;lng,lat;lng,lat;…` in plain decimal degrees (longitude first, as in `bbox`; points separated by `;`). Ex: `37.50,55.70;37.60,55.70;37.50,55.80` (a triangle in south-west Moscow).
- 3 to 100 points; the ring is closed for you (repeating the first point is optional).
- Longitudes run -180..180: Chukotka east of the antimeridian is `-180`…`-169`, and a shape may cross the antimeridian (e.g. `170,60;-175,60;-175,70;170,70`).
- Every point must lie at latitude 0 or north, and the shape must not cross the prime meridian (else 400).
- Combines with `bbox` and every other filter.
- It is a place filter. Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- With `village_id` it narrows the village.

max_metro_minutes.description:
**Maximum travel time to the nearest linked metro station, in minutes.** Optional; a multiple of 5 from `5` to `120` (else 400). Ex: `5`, `10`, `15`.

- Measured on foot by default; `metro_travel=transport` measures by public transport instead.
- Only listings with a linked metro station can match, so this also drops listings outside metro cities.
- Rows carry `metro[].minutes` and `metro[].travel` in Moscow and Saint Petersburg (for a few listings the station that qualifies is not the one the row shows).
- In the other metro cities rows carry no `metro` and the filter matches broadly  -  `bbox` or `polygon` is the precise tool there.

metro_travel.description:
**How `max_metro_minutes` is measured.** Optional; default `walk`; needs `max_metro_minutes` (else 400).

- `walk`  -  on foot (the listing's walking time must be within the limit)
- `transport`  -  by public transport (Cian's own estimate; rows may still show the walking time)

mkad_distance_min_km.description:
**Minimum distance from Moscow's ring road (МКАД), in km.** Optional; 0 - 1000. Ex: `10`.

- Mainly for suburban property around Moscow; rows carry `highways[].distance_km`.
- A row can list fewer highways than the listing has, and the distance that qualifies can be along another highway  -  the full offer card (`/offer`) lists every one.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

mkad_distance_max_km.description:
**Maximum distance from Moscow's ring road (МКАД), in km.** Optional; 0 - 1000. Ex: `30` (the near-Moscow belt), `60`.

- Mainly for suburban property around Moscow.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

price_min.description:
**Minimum price, in roubles (RUB).** Optional; 0 to one trillion. Ex: `5000000`, `50000` (monthly rent).

- For rent it is the price per period (per month for `long`, per day for `daily`); with `price_per_m2=true` it is the price per square metre.
- For a coworking place it is the listing's whole monthly price  -  all its workplaces, the row's `price_whole_office_rub`  -  not one workplace's (`price`, `price_per_workplace`).
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

price_max.description:
**Maximum price, in roubles (RUB).** Optional; 0 to one trillion. Ex: `15000000` (sale), `80000` (monthly rent), `3000` (per day).

- For rent it is the price per period; with `price_per_m2=true` the price per square metre; for a coworking place the whole listing's monthly price (the row's `price_whole_office_rub`).
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

price_per_m2.description:
**Read `price_min` / `price_max` as the price per square metre** instead of the total price. Optional; needs a price bound (else 400).

- Ex: `price_min=1000000&price_per_m2=true`  -  flats at 1 million ₽/m² or more.
- For commercial RENT the per-m² price is per YEAR, as the rows' `price_per_m2_formatted` states («… ₽/м² в год»): `price_min=50000&price_per_m2=true` is 50,000 ₽ per m² per year.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

area_min.description:
**Minimum total area, in whole m².** Optional; up to 1,000,000. Ex: `40`, `100`.

- Applies to every property type (for a house it is the house area; for land use `land_area_min`). Rows carry `total_area_m2`.
- A commercial listing offering several premises matches when one of them fits.
- For `room` it is the WHOLE flat's area (a room row's `total_area_m2` is the room itself  -  filter that with `room_area_min` / `room_area_max`).
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

area_max.description:
**Maximum total area, in whole m².** Optional; up to 1,000,000. Ex: `60`, `150`.

- Applies to every property type. Rows carry `total_area_m2`. For `room` it is the whole flat's area  -  use `room_area_max` for the room itself.
- Coworking rows carry no area (an office's is on its `/offer` card, `total_area_m2`); desks have none and always pass `area_max`.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

living_area_min.description:
**Minimum living area, in whole m²** (жилая площадь  -  the rooms, without kitchen and hallways). Optional. Ex: `30`.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the value.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

living_area_max.description:
**Maximum living area, in whole m².** Optional. Ex: `50`.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

kitchen_area_min.description:
**Minimum kitchen area, in whole m².** Optional. Ex: `10`, `15`.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the value.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

kitchen_area_max.description:
**Maximum kitchen area, in whole m².** Optional. Ex: `8`.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

room_area_min.description:
**Minimum area of the room itself, in whole m²**  -  for rooms in a shared flat (комната) and beds (the room the bed is in). Optional. Ex: `15`.

- **Applies to residential (`room`, `bed`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- A room row's `total_area_m2` is this room area (the flat's own area is on the `/offer` card as `flat_total_area_m2`, and `area_min` / `area_max` filter by it).
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

room_area_max.description:
**Maximum area of the room itself, in whole m².** Optional. Ex: `12`.

- **Applies to residential (`room`, `bed`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Rows carry the room area in `total_area_m2`.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

land_area_min.description:
**Minimum land plot, in whole sotkas** (1 sotka = 100 m²; 1 hectare = 100 sotkas). Optional. Ex: `6`, `15`.

- **Applies to suburban property types** (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`, `land`) **and to `commercial_land` on its own**; with any other `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- Rows carry the plot as the listing states it: `land_area_sotka` (in sotkas) or `land_area_ha` (in hectares  -  1 ha = 100 sotkas for this filter).
- Plots are compared in whole sotkas (the fraction is dropped), so `land_area_max=6` also returns a 6.9-sotka plot.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

land_area_max.description:
**Maximum land plot, in whole sotkas** (1 sotka = 100 m²). Optional. Ex: `10`, `30`.

- **Applies to suburban property types** (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`, `land`) **and to `commercial_land` on its own**; with any other `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- Compared in whole sotkas: `land_area_max=6` also returns plots of 6.1 - 6.9 sotkas.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.
- Whole numbers only: a fraction (e.g. `40.5`) is rejected with 400.

floor_min.description:
**Lowest floor the listing may be on.** Optional; −5 to 200. Ex: `2` (not ground floor), `10`.

- Basement levels count as `-1` (semi-basement, plinth floor) and `-2` (basement): `floor_max=-1` returns basement premises.
- Rows carry `floor` (`null` on a basement level) and the summary's floor text in `floor_text` («4/16 этаж», «полуподвал», «подвал»).
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

floor_max.description:
**Highest floor the listing may be on.** Optional; −5 to 200. Ex: `5`.

- Basement levels count as `-1` (semi-basement, plinth floor) and `-2` (basement).
- Rows carry `floor` (`null` on a basement level) and `floor_text`.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

floors_total_min.description:
**Minimum number of floors in the building** (for a house, its storeys). Optional. Ex: `9`, `25` (high-rises).

- Rows carry `floors_total`.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage`, `business` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

floors_total_max.description:
**Maximum number of floors in the building** (for a house, its storeys). Optional. Ex: `5` (low-rise, e.g. five-storey blocks), `1` (single-storey houses).

- Rows carry `floors_total`.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage`, `business` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

first_floor.description:
**Ground-floor listings.** Optional; omit for no filter.

- `only`  -  only listings on the first (ground) floor. **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `exclude`  -  leave ground-floor listings out. **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.

exclude_last_floor.description:
**Leave out listings on the top floor of their building.** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Rows carry `floor` and `floors_total`.

year_built_min.description:
**Earliest year the building was built.** Optional. Ex: `2000`, `2015` (modern stock).

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage`, `business` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The building registry's year counts where there is one  -  the full offer card (`/offer`) carries it as `bti.year_built`  -  and the seller's `building.build_year` otherwise (a flat card can have only the registry year).
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

year_built_max.description:
**Latest year the building was built.** Optional. Ex: `1960` (Stalin-era and older).

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage`, `business` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

ceiling_height_min.description:
**Minimum ceiling height, in metres.** Optional; 1 - 20. Ex: `2.7`, `3` (high ceilings).

- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the building's ceiling height.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

ceiling_height_max.description:
**Maximum ceiling height, in metres.** Optional; 1 - 20. Ex: `2.6` (low-ceilinged blocks).

- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the building's ceiling height.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

building_material.description:
**Building construction material.** Optional. Ex: `brick,monolith_brick`.

- `brick` (кирпичный) · `monolith` (монолитный) · `monolith_brick` (монолитно-кирпичный) · `panel` (панельный)
- `block` (блочный) · `wood` (деревянный) · `boards` (щитовой) · `stalin` (сталинский) · `old_fund` (старый фонд)

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- For flats the building registry's material counts where there is one (`/offer` `bti.house_material`, e.g. «Панельный»); the seller's own `building.material` on the same card can say otherwise.

renovation.description:
**State of repair of the flat or house.** Optional. Ex: `euro,designer`.

- `none`  -  without repair (incl. new builds without finishing) · `cosmetic`  -  cosmetic repair
- `euro`  -  euro-standard renovation (евроремонт) · `designer`  -  designer renovation

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- For commercial premises use `commercial_condition`.

window_view.description:
**Where the windows face.** Optional.

- `yard`  -  onto the courtyard (also matches flats facing both ways)
- `street`  -  onto the street (also matches flats facing both ways)
- `yard_and_street`  -  both ways only

**Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.

bathrooms_min.description:
**Minimum number of bathrooms / WCs** (separate and combined together). Optional; 1 - 10. Ex: `2`.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the counts.

bathroom_type.description:
**Kind of bathroom** (санузел). Optional.

- `combined`  -  a combined bathroom (совмещённый: toilet and bath in one room)
- `separate`  -  a separate WC (раздельный)

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- A flat with both kinds matches either value; most listings state neither and match neither.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the counts in `combined_wcs_count` and `separate_wcs_count`. For how many, use `bathrooms_min`.

balconies_min.description:
**Minimum number of balconies.** Optional; 1 - 10. Ex: `1`.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- Loggias are counted separately  -  use `with_loggia`.

with_loggia.description:
**Only flats with at least one loggia** (лоджия  -  a recessed, enclosed balcony). Optional.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

passenger_lifts_min.description:
**Minimum number of passenger lifts in the building.** Optional; 1 - 20. Ex: `1` (any lift), `2`.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The building registry's lifts count where there are any (the full offer card's `bti.lifts`, the whole building), the seller's `building.passenger_lifts` otherwise  -  a card can show `0` or nothing there and still match.

cargo_lifts_min.description:
**Minimum number of freight lifts (грузовые лифты) in the building.** Optional; 1 - 20. Ex: `1`, `2`.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the count (`building.cargo_lifts`).

apartments_only.description:
**Only apartments (апартаменты)**  -  units with non-residential legal status, typical of business-class towers. Optional.

- **Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Rows carry `is_apartment: true` only where their summary names the apartment («апарт.»), else `null`; the full offer card (`/offer`) carries `is_apartment` for every listing.
- The opposite is `exclude_apartments`.

exclude_apartments.description:
**Leave apartments (апартаменты) out**  -  flats with residential legal status only. Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Together with `apartments_only=true` it is rejected with 400. The two split a search exactly.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `is_apartment`.

penthouse_only.description:
**Only listings the seller marked as a penthouse.** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

with_finishing.description:
**Only new-build flats sold with some interior finishing declared (с отделкой)**  -  any grade: fine, white box (pre-fine) or shell. Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Meaningful with `building_stage=new`; `finishing_type` picks the grade.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

finishing_type.description:
**Grade of the interior finishing of a new-build flat** (отделка). Optional. Ex: `fine,pre_fine`.

- `fine`  -  ready finish (чистовая: move in and furnish) · `pre_fine`  -  white box (предчистовая: walls and screed done, fixtures to fit)
- `rough`  -  shell (черновая) · `without`  -  no finishing declared (includes almost every resale flat)

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) names the grade in `newbuilding.decoration_text` («Чистовая», «Предчистовая», «Черновая»); `newbuilding.decoration` (`fine`, `rough`) is often `null`  -  always for white box, and for some shell flats too.

renovation_program.description:
**Buildings in Moscow's housing-renovation (demolition) programme** (программа реновации). Optional.

- `only`  -  only buildings scheduled for demolition and resettlement
- `exclude`  -  leave them out

**Applies to residential property types** (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`); with a suburban or commercial `property_type` it is rejected with 400.

mortgage_allowed.description:
**Only listings that can be bought with a mortgage** (ипотека возможна). Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `flat_share`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `land`, `townhouse`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

kitchen_stove.description:
**Kitchen stove type**  -  in practice, whether the building has mains gas. Optional.

- `gas`  -  gas stove (the building registry lists a central gas supply)
- `electric`  -  electric stove (no gas in the building  -  typical of high-rises built since the 1970s)

**Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.

parking_type.description:
**Parking at the building.** Optional. Ex: `underground,multilevel`.

- `underground` (подземная) · `ground` (наземная) · `multilevel` (многоуровневая) · `open` (открытая)

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) or commercial (every commercial type except `business` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries the same value in `building.parking_type`.

homeowner_only.description:
**Only listings published by the owner (собственник)**, not by an agent. Optional.

- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Rows carry `is_by_homeowner`.

developer_only.description:
**Only listings published by a developer (застройщик)** or its official sales partner  -  new-build flats from the developer, or houses and plots sold by the cottage-village developer. Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) or suburban (`house`, `land`, `townhouse`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Rows carry `is_from_developer` (and, for a village, `village_id`).

commercial_owner_only.description:
**Only premises offered by their verified owner** (собственник: the landlord itself, its management company or rental department) rather than a broker. Optional.

- **Applies to commercial (every commercial type except `garage` and `coworking`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `commercial.is_by_commercial_owner` (the owner in person).

auction.description:
**Auction lots (торги)  -  property sold or leased through an electronic trading platform** (bankruptcy, state and municipal sales). Optional.

- `only`  -  only auction lots; sale rows carry `is_auction_sale: true` and the lot page in `trading_link`, except a few banks' direct sales of repossessed property filed with them (no flag). On commercial RENT it also returns premises leased out by tender (e.g. state-corporation rentals), whose rows carry `is_auction_sale: false` and no `trading_link`
- `exclude`  -  leave auction lots out

**Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `flat_share`) for sale (`deal=sale`), suburban (`house`, `land`, `townhouse`) for sale (`deal=sale`) or commercial (every commercial type except `coworking`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.

unique_only.description:
**Only unique listings  -  drop duplicates of the same property published by several agents.** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`), suburban (`house`, `land`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Duplicates are common on flat sales, so this can shrink the result a lot.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Rows carry `is_unique`.

has_photo.description:
**Listings with or without photos.** Optional.

- `true`  -  only listings with at least one photo; `false`  -  only listings without any (a small minority); omit for both.
- Rows carry `photos` and `photo_count`.

with_video.description:
**Only listings with a video.** Optional.

- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Rows carry `videos`.

with_layout.description:
**Only listings with a floor plan** among their photos. Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`, `flat_share`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `land`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type except `coworking`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.
- Flat and suburban rows mark plan images with `photos[].is_layout` (a few leave it to the offer card, `/offer`).
- Commercial rows never mark one: there the plan is the `/offer` card's `layout_photo`.

has_viewing_booking.description:
**Only new-build flats whose viewing can be booked online** (онлайн-запись на просмотр в ЖК). Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Resale flats never match (with `building_stage=resale` the result is empty).
- The complexes offering it are `/newbuildings?has_viewing_booking=true`; rows name the complex in `newbuilding`, and each matched flat's `/offer` card has `newbuilding.has_viewing_booking: true` (with the complex's `newbuilding.viewing_schedule`).
- In a complex that takes bookings only the developer's own flats match.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

handover_year_min.description:
**New-build flats whose building is handed over (срок сдачи) in this year or later.** Optional; 2000 - 2100. Ex: `2028`.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- A building already handed over counts with its completion year, so the current year or earlier keeps some finished buildings; use next year for "not yet completed".
- Resale flats are not filtered by it: with `building_stage=resale` it is rejected with 400; pair it with `building_stage=new` to list new builds alone.
- Rows show the complex's timetable in `newbuilding.stage` («Сдача в 2 кв. 2028»); the full offer card (`/offer`) has the flat's own building in `building.deadline.year`.

has_3d_tour.description:
**Listings with or without a 3D tour** (виртуальный 3D-тур). Optional.

- `true`  -  only listings with a tour; `false`  -  only listings without one; omit for both.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Rows carry `has_3d_tour`; the full offer card (`/offer`) has the tour link in `tour_url`.

featured_only.description:
**Only the developer's own flats in a featured (boosted) residential complex**  -  a complex whose developer pays Cian to promote it (фичеринг). Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Rows carry the complex-level flag in `newbuilding.is_featured` (`true` on every match); an agent's listing in the same complex carries the flag too but never matches  -  every match has `is_from_developer: true`.
- Resale flats never match.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

featured_plus_only.description:
**Only the developer's own flats in a complex featured at the higher «plus» tier** (a subset of `featured_only`). Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Rows carry `newbuilding.is_featured_plus` (`true` on every match, with `is_featured: true`), and every match has `is_from_developer: true`.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

sale_type.description:
**How a resale flat is sold.** Optional.

- `free`  -  free sale (свободная продажа: the seller is not buying another home in the same deal)
- `alternative`  -  alternative sale (альтернативная сделка: tied to the seller's own purchase)

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `flat_share`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Listings that state neither match neither value.
- New-build flats are sold under other contracts: with `building_stage=new` it is rejected with 400; pair it with `building_stage=resale` to list resale flats alone.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries it in `price_details.sale_type`; a free sale's row `terms` usually starts «Свободная продажа».

flat_rooms.description:
**How many rooms the flat has** that the room, bed or share on offer is in. Optional. Ex: `2,3`, `3`.

- **Applies to residential (`room`, `bed`, `flat_share`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Up to 10 comma-separated whole numbers from 1 to 20, combined with **OR**.
- For whole flats use `rooms`. The full offer card (`/offer`) carries it as `flat_rooms_count`.

prepay_months_max.description:
**Prepayment of at most this many months (предоплата).** Optional; 1 - 12. Ex: `1`.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Listings stating no prepayment are left out.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries it in `price_details.prepay_months`.

room_type.description:
**Layout of the room on offer** (for `property_type=room` or `bed`  -  the room the bed is in). Optional.

- `separate`  -  a separate room (изолированная) · `combined`  -  a walk-through, adjoining room (смежная)
- `both`  -  the seller marked both

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`room`, `bed`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Most room listings state no layout, so each value matches a minority; `combined` also returns some rooms marked both.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries it in `room_type`.

in_residential_complex.description:
**Only flats inside a residential complex (ЖК)**  -  new builds and resales in the complex alike. Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `flat_share`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Every row names its complex in `newbuilding` (`newbuilding_id`, name, stage).
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

published_within.description:
**Only listings published or re-published within this time.** Optional.

- minutes: `10m`, `15m`, `30m` · hours: `1h`, `2h`, `3h`, `4h`, `6h`, `12h` · days: `1d`, `2d`, `3d`, `7d`, `30d`

A listing the seller renewed or raised counts as fresh, so a row's `created_at` can be older than the window.
Map one window against another (e.g. `1d` vs `7d`) to see where new supply arrives.

keywords.description:
**Words or phrases the listing description must contain (in Russian).** Optional. Ex: `камин` (fireplace), `терраса,панорамные окна`, `без ремонта`.

- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- Up to 10 entries of up to 60 characters, each with at least 2 letters or digits (a symbol-only entry is rejected with 400).
- The EXACT word form matches, not its other cases or numbers (`ипотека`, `ипотеке` and `ипотеку` match different listings), so list the forms you need: `ипотека,ипотеки,ипотеке,ипотеку,ипотекой`.

keywords_exclude.description:
**Words or phrases the listing description must NOT contain (in Russian).** Optional. Ex: `ипотека`, `апартаменты,аукцион`.

- Comma-separated; a listing containing ANY of them is left out.
- Up to 10 entries of up to 60 characters, each with at least 2 letters or digits.
- Only the EXACT word form is left out  -  `ипотека` still lets through descriptions saying «в ипотеке» or «ипотеку»  -  so list every form to exclude (`ипотека,ипотеки,ипотеке,ипотеку,ипотекой`).
- A word in both `keywords` and `keywords_exclude` is rejected with 400.

rent_amenities.description:
**Equipment the rental must have.** Optional. Ex: `furniture,washing_machine,internet`.

- `furniture` · `kitchen_furniture` · `fridge` · `washing_machine` · `dishwasher` · `air_conditioner`
- `tv` · `internet` · `bathtub` · `shower` · `phone_line` (a landline; residential rentals and houses and townhouses for rent only  -  house parts and commercial rentals have none)

**Rules**

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Commercial rentals (except garages) take `furniture` only.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **AND** (a listing must have EVERY one listed).
- For unfurnished rentals use `furnished=false`.

furnished.description:
**Furnished rentals, or those not marked furnished.** Optional.

- `true`  -  furnished only (same as `rent_amenities=furniture`); `false`  -  every rental NOT marked furnished, including those that say nothing either way (rows with `has_furniture: null` or `false`); omit for both.
- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type except `garage`, `commercial_land` and `coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Rows carry `has_furniture`. For coworking places use `coworking_amenities=furniture`.

kids_allowed.description:
**Only rentals where children are allowed.** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

pets_allowed.description:
**Only rentals where pets are allowed.** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

no_deposit.description:
**Only rentals without a security deposit (без залога).** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`) or suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

no_commission.description:
**Only rentals without an agent's commission for the tenant (без комиссии).** Optional.

- **Applies to residential (`flat`, `room`, `bed`), suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) or commercial (every commercial type) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

land_status.description:
**Legal category of the land plot.** Optional.

- `individual_housing`  -  ИЖС (individual housing construction) · `gardening`  -  садоводство (СНТ)
- `dacha_partnership`  -  ДНП · `private_farm`  -  ЛПХ (private subsidiary farm) · `farm`  -  фермерское хозяйство
- `industrial`  -  land for industry, transport and communications · `investment_project`  -  investment project

**Rules**

- **Applies to suburban property types** (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`, `land`); with any other `property_type` it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).

suburban_features.description:
**Utilities and extras the house or plot must have.** Optional. Ex: `gas,water,sewerage`.

- utilities: `gas` · `electricity` · `water` · `sewerage`
- extras: `garage` · `bathhouse` (баня) · `pool` · `security` (guarded)

**Rules**

- **Applies to suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `land`, `townhouse`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- On suburban RENTALS only `garage`, `bathhouse` and `pool` can be filtered (the others are rejected with 400 there).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **AND** (a listing must have EVERY one listed).

heating_type.description:
**How the house is heated.** Optional. Ex: `central_gas,electric`.

- `central_gas`  -  gas (центральное газовое) · `electric` · `stove` (печь) · `fireplace` (камин)
- `central_coal`  -  coal (центральное угольное) · `none`  -  no heating

**Rules**

- **Applies to suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `land`, `townhouse`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries it as `building.heating` (`centralGas`, `electric`, `stove`, …).

dacha.description:
**Dachas (дача  -  a seasonal country house).** Optional.

- `only`  -  only houses the seller listed as a dacha
- `exclude`  -  leave dachas out

**Rules**

- **Applies to suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `land`, `townhouse`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `suburban.is_dacha`.

bedrooms_min.description:
**Minimum number of bedrooms in the house.** Optional; 1 - 20. Ex: `3`.

- **Applies to suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `bedrooms_count`.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

bedrooms_max.description:
**Maximum number of bedrooms in the house.** Optional; 1 - 20. Ex: `2`, or `bedrooms_min=2&bedrooms_max=2` for exactly two.

- **Applies to suburban (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `bedrooms_count`.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

toilet_location.description:
**Where the toilet is.** Optional.

- `indoor`  -  inside the house
- `outdoor`  -  outside (a yard toilet)

**Applies to suburban property types** (`house`, `house_part`, `townhouse`, `land`); with any other `property_type` it is rejected with 400.

commercial_condition.description:
**Condition of commercial premises.** Optional. Ex: `property_type=office&commercial_condition=office,design`.

- `office`  -  office fit-out (офисная отделка) · `finishing`  -  ready for final finishing (под чистовую отделку)
- `typical`  -  standard repair (типовой ремонт) · `design`  -  designer repair (дизайнерский ремонт)
- `cosmetic_repairs_required` · `major_repairs_required`

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`office`, `retail`, `warehouse`, `free_purpose`, `public_catering`, `production`, `car_service`, `building`, `domestic_services`, `coworking`; `retail` and `public_catering` for rent (`deal=rent`) only) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send exactly one `property_type` with it (several are rejected with 400).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries it as `commercial.condition` (`office`, `finishing`, `majorRepairsRequired`, …).

building_class.description:
**Class of the building or business centre** (A+, A, B+, B, B−, C, D). Optional. Ex: `a,a_plus`.

- `a_plus` · `a` · `b_plus` · `b` · `b_minus` · `c` · `d`

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`office`, `retail`, `free_purpose`, `public_catering`, `car_service`, `building`, `domestic_services`, `coworking`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- A premises matches on its business centre's class, so the building's own class on the card (`/offer` `building.class`: `aPlus`, `a`, `bPlus`, …) can differ by one step.

lease_type.description:
**Direct lease or sublease.** Optional.

- `direct`  -  leased directly from the owner (прямая аренда)
- `sublease`  -  a sublease from the current tenant (субаренда)

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (every commercial type except `garage` and `coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `price_details.lease_type`.

basement_type.description:
**Basement premises.** Optional.

- `basement` (подвал) · `semi_basement` (полуподвал / цоколь)

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (every commercial type except `garage`, `building` and `commercial_land`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- Only the "only these" direction exists (there is no "exclude basements" switch).
- Rows carry `floor: null` on a basement level and the level as written in `floor_text` («подвал», «полуподвал», «цоколь»); the `floor_min` / `floor_max` scale counts them as `-2` (basement) and `-1` (semi-basement).

garage_type.description:
**Kind of garage.** Optional.

- `parking_place`  -  a parking space (машиноместо) · `garage`  -  a garage · `box`  -  a lock-up box (бокс)

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`garage`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send `property_type=garage` alone (with other types it is rejected with 400).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `commercial.garage_type` (`parkingPlace`, `garage`, `box`).

garage_status.description:
**Legal status of the garage.** Optional.

- `ownership`  -  owned outright (собственность) · `cooperative`  -  in a garage co-operative (кооператив)
- `by_proxy`  -  held by power of attorney (по доверенности)

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`garage`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Send `property_type=garage` alone (with other types it is rejected with 400).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `commercial.garage_status` (`ownership`, `cooperative`, `byProxy`).

business_type.description:
**Kind of running business for sale** (готовый бизнес). Optional.

- `ready`  -  an operating business (a café, salon, shop … sold with its trade)
- `rental`  -  a rental business (арендный бизнес: premises sold together with their paying tenant)

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`business`) property types for sale (`deal=sale`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The two split the businesses for sale exactly.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `commercial.ready_business_type` (`readyBusiness` / `rentalBusiness`).

specialty_ids.description:
**What the premises or business is for** (специализация  -  café, shop, pharmacy, hotel …), by specialty id. Optional. Ex: `7007`  -  кафе/ресторан, `7037`  -  магазин (shop), `7023`  -  гостиница (hotel), `7006`  -  салон красоты.

- **Applies to commercial (`retail`, `public_catering`, `business`) property types**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Several ids combine with **OR**.
- Get the ids from the full offer card (`/offer`) of a similar listing: `commercial.specialties[]` (`specialty_id`, `code`, `name`); rows name the uses in `specialties`.
- A retail search also returns free-purpose premises declared suitable for retail (row `category` `freeAppointmentObject…`), which match on a related use rather than the exact id.

coworking_type.description:
**Kind of coworking place.** Optional; by default all three.

- `office`  -  a private office for a team (отдельный офис; row `summary` «Отдельный офис на 10 чел.»)
- `fixed_workplace`  -  a desk of your own (закреплённое место) · `flexible_workplace`  -  a hot desk (незакреплённое место)

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned).
- Rows carry the kind in `coworking.place_type` (the same three values; the source's own spelling in `coworking.place_type_raw`); the `/offer` card also in `commercial.coworking.place_type`.

workplaces_min.description:
**Minimum number of workplaces the listing offers** (an office for N people, or N desks). Optional; 1 - 10,000. Ex: `5`.

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The full offer card (`/offer`) carries `commercial.workplace_count`.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

workplaces_max.description:
**Maximum number of workplaces  -  for private offices.** Optional; 1 - 10,000. Ex: `9`.

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Desk listings (`fixed_workplace`, `flexible_workplace`) always pass it, whatever their desk count  -  a desk is rented singly.
- Send the `_min` alone for "at least", the `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is rejected with 400.

all_day_access.description:
**Only coworking places open round the clock** (доступ 24/7). Optional.

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The `/offer` card carries it as `commercial.coworking.is_round_the_clock` (`true` on every match).
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

all_week_access.description:
**Only coworking places open every day of the week**, weekends included. Optional.

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- The `/offer` card carries it as `commercial.coworking.access_type` (as served: `daily` on every match, `weekdays` otherwise).
- `true` applies the filter; `false` or omitting it means no filter.

coworking_amenities.description:
**What the coworking price must include.** Optional. Ex: `meeting_rooms,tea_coffee`.

- `wifi` · `bike_parking` · `high_speed_internet` · `rest_zone` · `cafe` · `cleaning` · `kitchen` · `furniture` · `security` · `parking` · `meeting_rooms` · `printer` · `reception` · `modern_renovation` · `gym` · `phone_booths` · `tech_support` · `events` · `fax` · `flipchart` · `fruits_snacks` · `tea_coffee` · `lockers` · `legal_address`

**Rules**

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **AND** (a listing must have EVERY one listed).
- The full offer card (`/offer`) lists what is included in `commercial.coworking.included` and what is not in `not_included`, in its own spelling: `bike_parking` = `bikeParking`, `high_speed_internet` = `internet`, `rest_zone` = `restZone`, `meeting_rooms` = `meetingRoom`, `modern_renovation` = `modern`, `phone_booths` = `phoneBooth`, `tech_support` = `techSupport`, `fruits_snacks` = `fruits`, `tea_coffee` = `tea`, `legal_address` = `legalAddress`.

coworking_ids.description:
**Coworking centres  -  every place for rent in them.** Optional. Ex: `95` (WORKKI CITY, Moscow).

- **Applies to commercial (`coworking`) property types for rent (`deal=rent`)**; anywhere else it is rejected with 400.
- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Several ids combine with **OR**.
- Get the id from any place in the centre: its `/search` row or `/offer` card carries `coworking.coworking_id` (with the centre's `name`).

description: Run a search from a pasted cian.ru search-results URL and get the same paged rows as /search.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description:
**A cian.ru search-results address, pasted from the browser.** Required. Any search page works:

- `https://www.cian.ru/cat.php?deal_type=sale&engine_version=2&offer_type=flat&region=1&room2=1` (any filters)
- category pages: `https://www.cian.ru/kupit-kvartiru/`, `https://www.cian.ru/snyat-1-komnatnuyu-kvartiru/`, `https://www.cian.ru/kupit-dom/`, `https://www.cian.ru/snyat-ofis/`
- regional hosts and the mobile site: `https://spb.cian.ru/kupit-kvartiru/`, `https://kazan.cian.ru/…`, `m.cian.ru`

**Rejected with 400 (with the endpoint to use where there is one)**

- A scheme other than `https://` / `http://` (the scheme itself may be omitted), or a non-Cian address.
- The bare home page (`https://www.cian.ru/`)  -  it names no search.
- A single-listing page (`/sale/flat//`) → `/offer-by-url`; a residential-complex page → `/search?newbuilding_ids=`; a new-build catalogue page (`offer_type=newobject`, `/novostroyki/…`) → `/newbuildings`.
- A path that is not a search, and a `deal_type` / `offer_type` that is not recognised (an unknown value, or the key in capitals: `DEAL_TYPE=sale`) or sent twice with different values.

**How the URL is read**

- Land for rent (`offer_type=suburban`, `object_type[0]=3`, `deal_type=rent`) is searched as commercial land for rent (`property_group: commercial`, `offer_type=suburban` listed in `dropped_params`).
- Coworking URLs work: the site's coworking code `office_type[0]=13` is searched next to `coworking_offer_type` (the same listings), dropped and listed in `dropped_params` next to other office types, and rejected with 400 alone or on a sale URL (it needs a coworking kind 1 - 3; coworking places are rented only).
- A `cat.php` address without `engine_version=2` (an old or hand-written link) is read as the site reads its own links, which always carry it.
- List parameters the site writes with an index (`newobject[0]=839`, `district[0]=325`, `office_type[0]=2`, `house_material[0]=1`, `rooms_count[0]=3`, `coworking_id[0]=95`, …) may be written with or without an index, with `[]` or as a comma list (`district=13,325`).
- `apartment=0` (no apartments) is searched as the site's `only_flat=1`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
**Override the result order.** Optional; by default the order in the URL (`sort=…`) is kept, and a URL without one is read newest first.

- `newest`  -  newest listings first
- `oldest`  -  oldest listings first
- `price_asc`  -  cheapest first · `price_desc`  -  most expensive first
- `price_per_m2_asc` / `price_per_m2_desc`  -  by price per square metre (for `room`, of the whole flat)  -  residential and commercial only
- `area_desc`  -  largest total area first (for `room`, the whole flat's; for a commercial listing of several premises, its largest one  -  not the total its row shows)  -  not for `land` or `commercial_land` alone. Coworking desks have no area: area and per-m² sorts put them last, `price_per_m2_asc` first
- `land_area_desc`  -  largest land plot first  -  suburban only (commercial land plots do not follow it)
- `metro_nearest`  -  shortest walk to the metro first  -  residential and commercial only (outside Moscow and Saint Petersburg rows carry no metro, so the order cannot be checked on them)
- `street`  -  by street name, A - Я  -  residential and commercial only

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
**Page of results, 28 listings per page** (fixed  -  there is no page-size parameter). Optional; default `1`; accepts `1` - `54`.

**Paging**

- At most **1,500 listings per search** are served (54 pages; page 54 holds at most 16  -  fewer when an earlier page came back short).
- `total` is Cian's own count of the listings matching the search, `retrievable_total` what paging can reach, `max_page` the last page worth asking for and `has_more` whether to ask for the next one.
- A page past the end returns an empty `items` list, and some searches run out of rows before `max_page`  -  stop at the first empty page.
- To reach more than 1,500, split the search with the filters `/search` and `/agent-listings` take, sizing each part from its `total`: price bands, `bbox` tiles, `district_ids` or `published_within` split most searches.

**Developer listings run dry early, at any size**

- A search that holds flats sold by their developer  -  new-build flat sales (`building_stage=new`, `developer_only`, `developer_ids`, `featured_only` / `featured_plus_only`, `handover_year_min`) and flat sales without a `building_stage`, which include them  -  pages through only part of those flats, far below `total`, even when `total` is small; resale and homeowner listings page fully.
- There `retrievable_total` is only an upper bound, and neither a price band nor another order helps much.
- Split such a search by complex instead  -  one search per `newbuilding_ids` value taken from the rows' `newbuilding.newbuilding_id`: each complex pages fully.

description: Every live listing of one agent, agency or developer, grouped by deal and paged.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description:
**The agent, agency or developer whose listings to return.** Required. Ex: `133718242` (a developer), `87472388` (an agency).

- Use the `seller.agent_id` of any `/search` or `/offer` row, or the `agent_id` of `/agent`  -  private specialists, agencies and developers alike.
- An account's older `cian_user_id` (the rows' `seller.cian_user_id`) is accepted too: the response then names the account's real `agent_id` and says `id_matched_as: cian_user_id`.
- The id is read as an `agent_id` first whenever an account has it as one; `id_type` pins the id space, and `id_also_matches` names a second account the number is the `cian_user_id` of.
- An id naming no account returns 404, exactly as on `/agent`.

parameters.name: id_type
parameters.description:
**Which kind of id `agent_id` is.** Optional; by default it is detected: read as an `agent_id` first, and as an
account's older `cian_user_id` when no account has it as an `agent_id`.

- `agent_id`  -  only the account whose `agent_id` (the rows' `seller.agent_id`) is this number; 404 otherwise
- `cian_user_id`  -  only the account whose `cian_user_id` (the rows' `seller.cian_user_id`) is this number;
  404 otherwise

The two id spaces overlap: a number can be one account's `agent_id` and another account's `cian_user_id`  - 
the detected answer is then the `agent_id` account, and `id_also_matches` names the other one (send
`id_type=cian_user_id` to read it). Ids of other kinds (a `developer_id`, a region, complex or offer id) are
different spaces, but a number from one of them may happen to be some account's `cian_user_id` and resolve to
that account (`id_matched_as: cian_user_id` says so)  -  send `id_type=agent_id` to accept agent ids only.

parameters.name: deal
parameters.description:
**Which of the agent's listings: for sale or for rent.** Optional; by default the agent's largest group of listings is returned (see `portfolio`), and with only `property_group` / `property_type` the largest group of that kind.

- `sale`  -  listings for sale
- `rent`  -  listings for rent (long-term and daily together unless `rent_period` says otherwise)

schema.description:
**Which of the agent's listings: for sale or for rent.** Optional; by default the agent's largest group of listings is returned (see `portfolio`), and with only `property_group` / `property_type` the largest group of that kind.

- `sale`  -  listings for sale
- `rent`  -  listings for rent (long-term and daily together unless `rent_period` says otherwise)

parameters.name: property_group
parameters.description:
**Which group of the portfolio to list, every property kind in it included.** Optional; by default the group is taken from `property_type`, else the agent's largest group. Pair with `deal` to pick one `portfolio` entry exactly.

- `residential`  -  flats, rooms, beds and shares together
- `suburban`  -  houses, house parts, townhouses and land together
- `commercial`  -  every commercial kind, including ones `property_type` has no value for (e.g. commercial land)

A `property_type` from another group is rejected with 400.

- `suburban`  -  houses, house parts, townhouses and land together

A `property_type` from another group is rejected with 400.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description:
**Narrow the listed group to these property kinds.** Optional; by default every kind in the group is listed.

- **Residential:** `flat`  -  flats and apartments (narrow with `rooms`) · `room`  -  a room in a shared flat (комната) · `bed`  -  a bed (койко-место; rent only) · `flat_share`  -  a share of a flat (доля; sale only)
- **Suburban:** `house`  -  houses and cottages (дом, коттедж) · `house_part`  -  part of a house · `townhouse` · `land`  -  land plots (sale only)
- **Commercial:** `office` · `retail` (торговая площадь) · `warehouse` (склад) · `free_purpose` (помещение свободного назначения) · `public_catering` (общепит) · `garage` · `production` (производство) · `car_service` (автосервис) · `business` (готовый бизнес  -  a running business; sale only) · `building` (здание) · `domestic_services` (бытовые услуги) · `commercial_land` (коммерческая земля  -  plots for commercial use) · `coworking` (коворкинг  -  private offices and desks in a coworking centre; rent only)

**Rules**

- Comma-separated values must come from ONE group; mixing groups is rejected with 400 (run one search per group). Several values combine with **OR**.
- A kind listed for one deal only is rejected with 400 on the other: `bed` and `coworking` are rent only; `flat_share`, `land` and `business` sale only (plots offered for rent are `commercial_land`).
- Commercial types mean "suitable for": free-purpose premises declared suitable for an office also match `office`, so check each row's `category`.
- `office` for rent also matches coworking places (private offices and desks, rows with `coworking` set); `coworking` searches those alone.
- `commercial_land` is searched on its own, not with other types. Its rows carry `land_area_sotka` (or `land_area_ha`)  -  size it with `land_area_min` / `land_area_max`; `area_*` match only the few plots that state a floor area.
- `coworking` is searched on its own; narrow it with `coworking_type`, `workplaces_min` / `workplaces_max`, `coworking_amenities`, `all_day_access`, `all_week_access` and `coworking_ids`. Its rows state no area  -  an office's area is on its `/offer` card, desks have none.
- Ex: `flat`, `house,townhouse`.

- `commercial_land` is searched on its own, not with other types. Its rows carry `land_area_sotka` (or `land_area_ha`)  -  size it with `land_area_min` / `land_area_max`; `area_*` match only the few plots that state a floor area.
- `coworking` is searched on its own; narrow it with `coworking_type`, `workplaces_min` / `workplaces_max`, `coworking_amenities`, `all_day_access`, `all_week_access` and `coworking_ids`. Its rows state no area  -  an office's area is on its `/offer` card, desks have none.
- Ex: `flat`, `house,townhouse`.

parameters.name: rent_period
parameters.description:
**Long-term or daily rent.** Optional; default here `any`  -  the agent's long-term and daily rentals together. Applies to `deal=rent` only (rejected with 400 on sale listings).

- `long`  -  long-term rent, priced per month
- `daily`  -  daily rent (посуточно), priced per day
- `any`  -  both together

Commercial premises are rented long-term only (anything but `any` is rejected there).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description:
**Number of rooms of a flat.** Optional; omit for every layout.

- `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`  -  that many rooms · `6_plus`  -  six or more
- `studio`  -  studio (студия, incl. studio apartments) · `free_layout`  -  free layout (свободная планировка)

**Rules**

- Needs `flat` in `property_type` (else 400). Rooms, beds and shares are separate `property_type` values, not room counts.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching ANY of them is returned). Ex: `1,2` or `studio,1`.
- Rows carry `rooms` (`0` for a studio) and `is_studio`.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description:
**Region or city to search in.** Optional; omit to search all of Russia.

- `1`  -  Moscow · `4593`  -  Moscow Oblast · `2`  -  Saint Petersburg · `4588`  -  Leningrad Oblast
- a city: `4777`  -  Kazan (city ids narrow to the city; region ids such as `4618` Tatarstan cover the whole region)

**Rules**

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Several ids combine with **OR** (`1,2` = every Moscow listing plus every Saint Petersburg listing).
- Get region ids from `/regions` and city / town ids (`location_id`) from `/locations`; `/geocode` suggestions with `search_param: region_id` work too.
- A metro, district, street, house, highway, railway, complex or polygon filter REPLACES the region as the search area (`developer_ids` does not  -  it narrows within the region).
- Do not list a region together with a city inside it: the search then covers about the city alone  -  the region by itself already covers its cities.
- The union of several places is not always exact, even for distant ones: query a large city on its own when completeness matters.
- With `village_id` send at most one region (several are rejected with 400).

parameters.name: metro_ids
parameters.description:
**Metro stations the listing must be near.** Optional. Ex: `228`  -  Строгино (Moscow), `4,118`.

- Up to 15 comma-separated ids, each a whole number from 1 to 2147483647 (else 400). Get `station_id`s from `/metro-stations` (by city) or `/geocode` (by name).
- Add `max_metro_minutes` to bound the travel time.
- In **Moscow and Saint Petersburg** it returns the listings linked to the station, and rows carry it in `metro[].station_id`.
- In **other metro cities** (Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk, Nizhny Novgorod, Samara) listings are not linked to a station: the filter then selects a wide area around it  -  roughly a third to a half of the city  -  and rows carry an empty `metro`. Use `bbox` or `polygon` there for a real "near this station" search.
- Place filters (`metro_ids`, `district_ids`, `street_ids`, `house_ids`, `highway_ids`, `railway_ids`, `newbuilding_ids`, `polygon`) combine with **OR**, across types too, and when any is sent they **replace** `region_id` as the search area.
- Not combinable with `village_id` (rejected with 400)  -  only `polygon` and `bbox` narrow a village.
